summary: Third same-day tweak wave over the 2026-08-13 canon, sealed with dated wave-3 dispositions: live-fitting overflow chip immediately left of the actions cluster with newly-opened-tab visibility, animated tab drag-reorder (transform-only tracking, ~140 ms neighbour FLIP, silhouette glued to the insertion slot), theme skin tokens for the silhouette (retro hard outline, basic accent-blue crown, glass bevel at 84 percent rail alpha re-tuned from 88), minimap as the only code-pane scrollbar (native bars suppressed, margin-aligned), two-frame drop-target hysteresis with mid-FLIP hit-test exclusion and the proportional-projected-width placeholder, PM_EDGE deferral across all Home gestures, the vertical-dots 16x20 kebab at the surface's right edge below the grip (stray terminal control strip removed), 2 px vertical workspace padding via --pm-home-pad-y/--pm-home-gap-y, and truth-gated terminal empty-section guidance with restoreOwnerRefs never dropping section records. Artifact rebuilt at sha256 d13b91e9 on the repinned base adc713c5. No new command IDs; no storage shape changes; census unchanged at 56 home rows with the 14 kebab-anchored option rows re-worded. Four-fix follow-up (user-reported, same wave): Safari drag-image compatibility (attached off-viewport ghost backing setDragImage plus a -webkit-user-drag hint), the terminal repair generalized (any paneless live-workgroup ref reconstitutes a minimal pane - never nulled, and the empty block never renders over a live workgroup), overflow fitters fitting against the strip's content box with a 44 px actions-reserve floor covering the kebab column, and the retro outline moving to the active tab as a three-edge inset ring that snaps on arrival. Final artifact sha256 139c1f78 on the repinned base 6f5bdaec. Final wave-3 build (aacbaaf1 on repinned base 5142446d): the fitter overflow condition is content-box child-edge measurement at all three sites (edStripContentOverflows), retiring the naive scrollWidth comparison that collapsed all tabs on non-overflowing strips, and restoreOwnerRefs gained the anyLiveWorkgroup reseed - persisted-null corruption reseeds section 1 from the pristine terminal seed and heals the persisted domain-ref CSVs in the same pass.
